regions.today: A bright day today with sunny spells. After a dry start, scattered showers will spread from the west through the morning and afternoon. Highest temperatures of 17 to 21 degrees with light southwesterly winds increasing light to moderate westerly through the day.
regions.tonight: Mostly dry tonight with clear spells and just isolated showers. It will become somewhat cloudier in the midlands towards morning. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 9 degrees in a light southwest breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be a dry day with spells of sunshine developing through the morning, turning hazier in the afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 19 to 22 degrees in a light to moderate westerly breeze.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Friday and Saturday.
